about: atb_no_leaf (OBS-6): ATB codes that are legal in the shared map but have no leaf on this chip (no SEL=atbX_sw[code-1] or FORCE_LEAF binding in integration/chips/common.conn + <chip>/chip.conn; rtl/gen/gen_regfile.py checks the list against the conns); pt_regfile rejects them at write time on that chip (cfg_err[0], like any illegal encoding). The two chips of the split (MANDATE 1, scratch/reviews/SPLIT-PLAN.md, assignment scratch/reviews/split/assignment.md). One block library, one RTL, one register address map: this file says which enable groups, islands and register fields each chip has. Read by integration/chips/check_top.py, verification/check_contract.py and spec/check_performance_requirements.py. A field is on a chip unless it matches the other chip's only-list.

rf.name: pt_rf
rf.scope: RF receive and transmit, LO synthesis (QVCO, dividers, LO regulator), external-LO input, ADC/DAC I/Q, baseband filter, RF test structures, plus the shared infrastructure, the TX ring and (D2) the CDR ring as the second host-clock route

wired.name: pt_wired
wired.scope: wired RX (CTLE, slicer, capture, CDR ring, phase trim, detect), wired TX (fast path, USB and 100BASE-TX drivers), forwarded/AUX clock, wired monitors, speed test structures, plus the shared infrastructure
